decisions.reason: The manual laser workstation extends the established laser line at low carrying cost, and its value is still uncertain since it is only mentioned on the website, so keeping the option is worthwhile.
The thermal inkjet printer is core to the firm's offer, has stayed on a dedicated page for two years, and costs little to keep alongside the existing consumables business.
The piezo inkjet printer is close to the core offer, has had steady dedicated-page presence, and its uncertainty is still resolving at low carrying cost.
Featured on the home page, the industrial laser marking systems are a strategic growth line, so the option is being actively exercised rather than abandoned.
The newly launched laser cabin is promoted on its own page and has had too little time for its uncertainty to resolve, which makes keeping it the better choice.
The lubricant printing system won a trade fair award, a positive signal that its value is likely to be realized in the sheet metal niche.
